environment: Actual host material leaf with a saved owned site configuration and real isolated local HTTP peers. No new package or browser suite execution.
observations: POST retained the source recipe query fields and its selected Cookie.
The host followed a same-origin redirect, extracted the nested JSON token, fetched exact bencoded material with letdown=1, and retained its hash.
The final GET did not send recipe or configured-site cookies. [] skipped the first request. Cross-origin redirect was rejected before the other HTTP peer received a request.
adaptation: Only the configured origin may receive authenticated recipe requests or their redirects. Native provider paths such as M-Team keep their separate existing boundaries.
